tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen and the bottom action bar. Warm flour tone.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, lists, rows, sheets' inner controls, the tab bar. Sits on bg.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Chips, segmented-control track, stepper buttons, the lock bar: controls that sit lower than a card.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Row separators, empty progress segments, the tab bar's top edge.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Switch track when off, grabber, cake-stand shading. Decorative: 1.5:1 on surface, so it never carries meaning alone (the switch thumb position does).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, sunken and every tint. Also the primary button fill. 16:1 on bg.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, row descriptions, captions. 6:1 on bg, 5.6:1 on sunken.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled labels, chevrons, unchecked checkbox and radio outlines, inactive tab icons. 3.5:1 on bg and 3.8:1 on surface: enough for icons and outlines, never body copy.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text and icons on text-coloured fills (primary button, selected chip, toast).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Strawberry pink. Accent button fill (with text on top), progress segments, the bake timeline. Never as text.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Pink as text or icon: overlines, links, the selected tab, the selected radio. 5.9:1 on surface, 5.4:1 on brand-tint.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Soft pink ground: today's order card, selected recipe row, secondary button, the launch screen.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Mint. Switch on, step ticks, friends' progress bars, break segments. Fill only.

tokens.name: success-strong
tokens.usage: Mint as text: the live “12 baking” label. 4.9:1 on surface.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Tile ground for social items (friends).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Sky blue. The coupon tile and map 'you are here' pin, decorate segment. Put text on it, never white.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Coupon card ground and sound tiles.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Lemon. Grade and discount tags, goal numbers, the pour progress line, toast emphasis. Text on it is text.

tokens.name: highlight-tint
tokens.usage: Reserved for highlighted backgrounds; not used on screens yet.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive alert actions (Open it, Leave). 5.2:1 on surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets and alerts.

tokens.name: pink-l
tokens.usage: Illustration and data colour: avatars, shop tiles, app icons. Not for UI chrome.

tokens.name: sky-l
tokens.usage: Illustration and data colour: avatars, shop tiles, app icons.

tokens.name: mint-l
tokens.usage: Illustration and data colour: avatars, shop tiles, app icons.

tokens.name: lemon-l
tokens.usage: Illustration and data colour: avatars, shop tiles, app icons.

tokens.name: caramel
tokens.usage: Illustration only: wood, crusts, oven feet.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Large title on the five tab screens.

styles.name: title1
styles.usage: Screen heroes inside a flow: today's order, the result verdict, prep readouts.

styles.name: title3
styles.usage: Section headers, sheet titles, stat numbers.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Nav bar titles, buttons, recipe names.

styles.name: callout
styles.sample: The recipe sets how long you'll study.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Hints, chips, small buttons, alert body.
styles.sample: Every 100 g of flour is 10 minutes of study.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tags, stat labels, week days, phase labels.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows in brand-strong; tab bar labels in sentence case.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: Running countdowns only: the bake timer and the break timer. Mono keeps digits from jumping.

tokens.name: sp-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside a label group (title over subtitle), progress segments.

tokens.name: sp-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, tags, stat tiles and list cards.

tokens.name: sp-3
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its text; button groups; section header to content.

tokens.name: sp-4
tokens.usage: Card and sheet inner padding; row side padding.

tokens.name: sp-5
tokens.usage: Screen gutter on both sides.

tokens.name: sp-6
tokens.usage: Space between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: sp-8
tokens.usage: Reserved for large separations; rarely needed.

tokens.name: cut-s
tokens.usage: Chamfer (45° corner cut, not a radius) for anything under 36px tall: chips, tags, checkboxes, switches, small buttons.

tokens.name: cut-m
tokens.usage: Chamfer for 36–56px pieces: buttons, inputs, tiles, stat tiles, segmented track, goal rows.

tokens.name: cut-l
tokens.usage: Chamfer for cards, lists, sheets, banners, the order card.

tokens.name: h-l
tokens.usage: Primary button and text field height.

tokens.name: h-m
tokens.usage: Secondary button, goal row, lock bar, row leading tile and avatar.

tokens.name: h-s
tokens.usage: Compact button, chip, stepper button, small avatar.

tokens.name: fs-display
tokens.usage: Same as the display style; for components that set size directly.

tokens.name: fs-title1
tokens.usage: Same as title1.

tokens.name: fs-title3
tokens.usage: Same as title3.

tokens.name: fs-headline
tokens.usage: Same as headline.

tokens.name: fs-body
tokens.usage: Same as body.

tokens.name: fs-callout
tokens.usage: Same as callout.

tokens.name: fs-subhead
tokens.usage: Same as subhead.

tokens.name: fs-footnote
tokens.usage: Same as footnote.

tokens.name: fs-caption
tokens.usage: Same as caption.

tokens.name: fs-overline
tokens.usage: Same as overline.

tokens.name: fs-clock
tokens.usage: Same as clock.
